description: cabf_tls_br.rs:ValidityMaxLint::check_cert passes now_unix (evaluation/current time) to sc081_validity_cap, but sc081_validity_cap docs say the cap should be applied based on issuance time (notBefore), not validation time. In operational mode (caller passes current time), a cert issued before 2026-03-15 with 300-day validity would incorrectly be flagged after 2026-03-15 (when the 200-day cap kicks in at evaluation time). The fix is to pass tbs.validity.not_before.to_unix_duration().as_secs() to sc081_validity_cap instead of now_unix.
title: ValidityMaxLint evaluates SC-081 cap at wrong time in operational mode
